idea-plugin.name: Git Branch Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Displays local Git branch notes next to local and remote branch names in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Annotates local and remote branches in the Git Log branch dashboard.
  • Lets you add, edit, and delete notes from native single-branch action menus.
  • Copies a remote note once when creating a new local tracking branch.
  • Copies a local note once when Push creates a remote branch with an exact source mapping.
  • Optionally shows the current local branch and its note in the status bar.
  • Stores all notes locally in the repository's Git configuration.
No external service or project file is required.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Adds locally stored notes for remote branches.
  • Adds native branch actions for creating, editing, and deleting notes.
  • Copies remote notes to newly created local tracking branches without overwriting local notes.
  • Copies local notes to remote branches created by IntelliJ IDEA Push without overwriting remote notes.
  • Makes the optional status-bar widget disabled by default.
